primary_claim: ML inference results were bitwise-reproducible within fixed hardware/software settings, and changes to setup factors such as attention algorithm, quantization method, or tensor parallelism produced consistent, detectable numerical 'fingerprints' that could serve as a signal for verifying AI datacenter compute claims.

effect.metric: bitwise-reproducibility of inference outputs across repeated runs within fixed settings
effect.value: results were bitwise-reproducible within fixed settings in nearly all cases studied; differences across production methods were consistent, not random

quote: In nearly all cases studied, results were bitwise-reproducible within fixed settings. Differences across production methods were consistent, not random.
